description: Deletes one saved webhook for good, so it stops firing at once. Take it when a connection is no longer wanted: "The old CRM is gone, remove that webhook." It needs the session, the webhook id from your list, and a clear yes from you. Look at the list first and call the webhook by its name, not only by its number. Nothing else on the site changes, and there is no way back. Side effect: it acts on your connected WordPress site; nothing else is touched. Words hosts use: delete webhook, remove webhook, stop webhook, old CRM, webhook gone

confirm.description: Must be true, set only after the host said that this webhook may be deleted.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

name: wi_delete_webhook
title: Delete an outgoing webhook
